description: §38.10.3 clean neg (S462) — an `onclient:*` handler that writes a channel cell stays on the client (a channel-cell write is client-side sync, §38.4; it is not a §12.2 trigger) and compiles with no E-CHANNEL-006. The delta from `channel/handler-onclient-inferred-broadcast` is the handler body: a cell write instead of `broadcast()`.
rationale: §12.2 Trigger 7: a channel-cell WRITE does NOT escalate — so the handler is not placed on the server and §38.10.3 does not reject it.
